interpretation_limits: Native clean-field conditions contain a learned ranking signal versus same-width identifier hashing and parameters-off/shuffled controls. This is one supplied-action task, not evidence of many learned tasks or universal encoder optimality.

Native gated balanced accuracy is lower than native linear at every executed budget; only n8 has both bug and project intervals wholly negative. There is no consistent justification here for making gated heads the default over linear heads.

Tuning-selected native top1 improves at n32/64, but the selected strategy still emits no positive recommendation at p1>=0.7 across all27 condition-runs; selected native forced positive recall is0/0/0.003977725 by budget. Ranking signal is not a qualified positive-action policy.
Confidence classification coverage=max(p)>=0.7 includes confident negatives. It differs from positive-action recommendation p1>=0.7 and from forced argmax balanced accuracy/positive recall.

Raw Jaccard is a deterministic source-only ranking control, not a calibrated probability. It yields31/48 top1 known-positive groups; native selected n64 has a higher point mean but both predeclared intervals include zero for native-selected minus Jaccard.

All-positive/negative majority artifacts are visible: prior predicts negative for every valid action, weighted forced accuracy0.554255319 yet balanced accuracy0.5 and positive recall0. Source-only selected strategies remain near this behavior.
Calibration prior0.375724638 is below heldout bug-weighted positive mass20.95/47=0.445744681. This is descriptive role shift, not a post-hoc recalibration instruction.

Eight unknown actions in four heldout bugs remain unknown; one bug has no valid action. Semantic metrics cover160actions/47bugs, ranking retains168actions/48bugs. Observed known-positive oracle44/48 is not a statement that the remaining four bugs are inherently undiagnosable.

Native versus hash cross-feature conditions share budget/seeds and heldout support, but training draws differ in8of9runs because four source-only TRAIN features are unavailable. Do not call this a perfectly isolated same-example representation ablation.

n8/32/64 counts gradient-training actions from equally many unique bugs. Label exposure also includes the full train pool for stratification plus130tuning actions and152calibration actions. n128 is explicitly unavailable under the frozen cap, not executed.

63 predeclared contrasts are descriptive and unadjusted; their fixed seeds are not independent subjects. Only five heldout projects support the project bootstrap, so project-population generalization is limited.
New clean-field study differs from the older whole-document study in inputs, target, split and runtime evidence. It does not by itself prove that whole-document pooling caused the previous failure.
Counterfactual recorded test-work replay is not measured live sequential latency, and its known-positive oracle ordering is not a minimum-cost bound.
